answer: Every identity starts by locking a dual-asset bond, half token and half stablecoin as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. The network catches countersigning a transaction never verified through random spot-checks on the canonical chain. Proof triggers the penalty: repeat offences inside sixteen epochs double the slash each time. A bond without an inlet behind it is just an username. No wander hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. The sonnet keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
